workarounds.symptom: [GHSA-gj48-438w-jh9v] Bleach clean() / Cleaner() fails to sanitize dangerous URI schemes in allowed formaction attributes (Affects bleach < 6.4.0)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade bleach to patched release >= 6.4.0: pip install --upgrade 'bleach>=6.4.0' (Advisory: GHSA-gj48-438w-jh9v)

workarounds.workaround: Upgrade bleach to patched release >= 6.4.0: pip install --upgrade 'bleach>=6.4.0' (Advisory: GHSA-8rfp-98v4-mmr6)
